items.text: Writing session: User is working on a literary thriller with multi-POV structure (three main characters whose stories converge). Key advice given: (1) Track plot points per character per chapter using a spreadsheet; (2) Make protagonist feel alive by putting her under pressure with costly choices rather than describing traits—give her internal contradictions; (3) Combat writer's block by lowering standards, writing messy drafts, and ending sessions mid-sentence/scene; (4) Avoid perfectionism trap by using bracketed placeholders like [SCENE WHERE THEY ARGUE] and writing scenes out of order. User identified their main problems: flat protagonist and momentum issues with weeks between writing sessions.
